activation: forward-only; schema installation precedes first eligible post-install mutation; no historical rows are backfilled

ordering.reader: WHERE outbox_id > :last_consumed_outbox_id ORDER BY outbox_id ASC LIMIT :bounded_batch

atomicity: membership mutation and outbox append use the same caller-owned SQLite connection and transaction; append never commits
immutability: UPDATE and DELETE are rejected by database triggers; IDs are never reused
retention: V1 retains all rows; a future bounded purge must prove every durable consumer cursor plus safety margin has passed an event, and may never purge unconsumed events
